vsm2.12:93.7: Yathā manussā pakatiyā aniddhimanto udake ummujjanimujjaṃ karonti,
vsm2.12:93.8: evameva so iddhimā cetovasippatto pathaviyā ummujjanimujjaṃ karoti, seyyathāpi udake’’ti (paṭi. ma. 3.11).
vsm2.12:94.1: Na kevalañca ummujjanimujjameva, nhānapānamukhadhovanabhaṇḍakadhovanādīsu yaṃ yaṃ icchati, taṃ taṃ karoti.
vsm2.12:94.2: Na kevalañca udakameva, sappitelamadhuphāṇitādīsupi yaṃ yaṃ icchati, taṃ taṃ
vsm2.12:94.3: idañcidañca ettakaṃ hotūti āvajjitvā parikammaṃ katvā adhiṭṭhahantassa yathādhiṭṭhitameva hoti.
vsm2.12:94.4: Uddharitvā bhājanagataṃ karontassa sappi sappimeva hoti. Telādīni telādīniyeva. Udakaṃ udakameva.
vsm2.12:94.5: So tattha temitukāmova temeti, na temitukāmo na temeti.
vsm2.12:94.6: Tasseva ca sā pathavī udakaṃ hoti sesajanassa pathavīyeva.
vsm2.12:94.7: Tattha manussā pattikāpi gacchanti, yānādīhipi gacchanti, kasikammādīnipi karontiyeva.
vsm2.12:94.8: Sace panāyaṃ tesampi udakaṃ hotūti icchati, hotiyeva.
vsm2.12:94.9: Paricchinnakālaṃ pana atikkamitvā yaṃ pakatiyā ghaṭataḷākādīsu udakaṃ, taṃ ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ paricchinnaṭṭhānaṃ pathavīyeva hoti.
vsm2.12:95.2: ettha yaṃ udakaṃ akkamitvā saṃsīdati, taṃ bhijjamānanti vuccati.
vsm2.12:95.4: Evaṃ gantukāmena pana pathavīkasiṇaṃ samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhāya
vsm2.12:95.5: ettake ṭhāne udakaṃ pathavī hotūti paricchinditvā parikammaṃ katvā vuttanayeneva adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ.
vsm2.12:95.6: Saha adhiṭṭhānena yathā paricchinnaṭṭhāne udakaṃ pathavīyeva hoti.
vsm2.12:96.7: Yathā manussā pakatiyā aniddhimanto abhijjamānāya pathaviyā gacchanti,
vsm2.12:96.8: evameva so iddhimā cetovasippatto abhijjamāne udake gacchati, seyyathāpi pathaviya’’nti (paṭi. ma. 3.11).
vsm2.12:97.1: Na kevalañca gacchati, yaṃ yaṃ iriyāpathaṃ icchati, taṃ taṃ karoti.
vsm2.12:97.2: Na kevalañca pathavimeva karoti, maṇisuvaṇṇapabbatarukkhādīsupi yaṃ yaṃ icchati,
vsm2.12:97.3: taṃ taṃ vuttanayeneva āvajjitvā adhiṭṭhāti, yathādhiṭṭhitameva hoti.
vsm2.12:97.4: Tasseva ca taṃ udakaṃ pathavī hoti, sesajanassa udakameva,
vsm2.12:97.5: macchakacchapā ca udakakākādayo ca yathāruci vicaranti.
vsm2.12:97.6: Sace panāyaṃ aññesampi manussānaṃ taṃ pathaviṃ kātuṃ icchati, karotiyeva.
vsm2.12:98.3: Evaṃ kātukāmena pana pathavīkasiṇaṃ samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhāya
vsm2.12:98.4: sace nisinno gantumicchati, pallaṅkappamāṇaṃ ṭhānaṃ paricchinditvā parikammaṃ katvā vuttanayeneva adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ.
vsm2.12:98.6: sace padasā gantukāmo hoti maggappamāṇanti evaṃ yathānurūpaṃ ṭhānaṃ paricchinditvā vuttanayeneva pathavī hotūti adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ,
vsm2.12:99.3: Pakatiyā pathavīkasiṇasamāpattiyā lābhī hoti, ākāsaṃ āvajjati.
vsm2.12:99.6: So ākāse antalikkhe caṅkamatipi tiṭṭhatipi nisīdatipi seyyampi kappeti.
vsm2.12:99.7: Yathā manussā pakatiyā aniddhimanto pathaviyaṃ caṅkamantipi…pe… seyyampi kappenti,
vsm2.12:99.8: evameva so iddhimā cetovasippatto ākāse antalikkhe caṅkamatipi…pe… seyyampi kappetī’’ti (paṭi. ma. 3.11).
vsm2.12:100.1: Ākāse gantukāmena ca bhikkhunā dibbacakkhulābhināpi bhavitabbaṃ.
vsm2.12:100.3: Antare utusamuṭṭhānā vā pabbatarukkhādayo honti, nāgasupaṇṇādayo vā usūyantā māpenti, nesaṃ dassanatthaṃ.
vsm2.12:100.5: Pādakajjhānaṃ samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhāya ākāso hotūti parikammaṃ katvā adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ.
vsm2.12:101.3: tena yaṃ yaṃ ṭhānaṃ ākāso hotūti adhiṭṭhāti, ākāsoyeva hotī’’ti.
vsm2.12:101.4: Kiñcāpi evamāha, atha kho tirokuṭṭapārihāriye vuttanayeneva paṭipajjitabbaṃ.
vsm2.12:101.5: Apica okāse orohaṇatthampi iminā dibbacakkhulābhinā bhavitabbaṃ, ayañhi sace anokāse nhānatitthe vā gāmadvāre vā orohati.
vsm2.12:101.7: Tasmā dibbacakkhunā passitvā anokāsaṃ vajjetvā okāse otaratīti.
vsm2.12:102.1: Imepi candimasūriye evaṃmahiddhike evaṃmahānubhāve pāṇinā parāmasati parimajjatīti
vsm2.12:102.2: ettha candimasūriyānaṃ dvācattālīsayojanasahassassa upari caraṇena mahiddhikatā,
vsm2.12:102.3: tīsu dīpesu ekakkhaṇe ālokakaraṇena mahānubhāvatā veditabbā.
vsm2.12:102.4: Evaṃ upari caraṇaālokakaraṇehi vā mahiddhike teneva mahānubhāve.
vsm2.12:103.1: Ayaṃ panassa iddhi abhiññāpādakajjhānavaseneva ijjhati, natthettha kasiṇasamāpattiniyamo.
vsm2.12:103.3: ‘‘Imepi candimasūriye…pe… parimajjatīti idha so iddhimā cetovasippatto candimasūriye āvajjati,
vsm2.12:103.6: So nisinnako vā nipannako vā candimasūriye pāṇinā āmasati parāmasati parimajjati.
vsm2.12:103.7: Yathā manussā pakatiyā aniddhimanto kiñcideva rūpagataṃ hatthapāse āmasanti parāmasanti parimajjanti,
vsm2.12:104.1: Svāyaṃ yadi icchati gantvā parāmasituṃ, gantvā parāmasati,
vsm2.12:104.2: yadi pana idheva nisinnako vā nipannako vā parāmasitukāmo hoti, hatthapāse hotūti adhiṭṭhāti,
vsm2.12:104.3: adhiṭṭhānabalena vaṇṭā muttatālaphalaṃ viya āgantvā hatthapāse ṭhite vā parāmasati, hatthaṃ vā vaḍḍhetvā.
vsm2.12:104.4: Vaḍḍhentassa pana kiṃ upādiṇṇakaṃ vaḍḍhati, anupādiṇṇakanti?
vsm2.12:105.2: ‘‘kiṃ panāvuso, upādiṇṇakaṃ khuddakampi mahantampi na hoti,
vsm2.12:105.3: nanu yadā bhikkhu tālacchiddādīhi nikkhamati, tadā upādiṇṇakaṃ khuddakaṃ hoti.
vsm2.12:105.4: Yadā mahantaṃ attabhāvaṃ karoti, tadā mahantaṃ hoti mahāmoggallānattherassa viyā’’ti.
vsm2.12:106.1: Ekasmiṃ kira samaye anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati bhagavato dhammadesanaṃ sutvā
vsm2.12:106.2: ‘‘sve, bhante, pañcahi bhikkhusatehi saddhiṃ amhākaṃ gehe bhikkhaṃ gaṇhathā’’ti nimantetvā pakkami.
vsm2.12:106.3: Bhagavā adhivāsetvā taṃdivasāvasesaṃ rattibhāgañca vītināmetvā paccūsasamaye dasasahassilokadhātuṃ olokesi.
vsm2.12:106.4: Athassa nandopanando nāma nāgarājā ñāṇamukhe āpāthamāgacchi.
vsm2.12:107.1: Bhagavā ‘‘ayaṃ nāgarājā mayhaṃ ñāṇamukhe āpāthamāgacchi, atthi nu kho assa upanissayo’’ti āvajjento
vsm2.12:107.3: ko nu kho imaṃ micchādiṭṭhito viveceyyā’’ti āvajjento
vsm2.12:107.5: Tato pabhātāya rattiyā sarīrapaṭijagganaṃ katvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi –
vsm2.12:107.6: ‘‘ānanda, pañcannaṃ bhikkhusatānaṃ ārocehi tathāgato devacārikaṃ gacchatī’’ti.
vsm2.12:108.2: So dibbaratanapallaṅke dibbena setacchattena dhāriyamānena tividhanāṭakehi ceva nāgaparisāya ca parivuto
vsm2.12:108.3: dibbabhājanesu upaṭṭhāpitaṃ annapānavidhiṃ olokayamāno nisinno hoti.
vsm2.12:108.4: Atha bhagavā yathā nāgarājā passati, tathā katvā tassa vitānamatthakeneva pañcahi bhikkhusatehi saddhiṃ tāvatiṃsadevalokābhimukho pāyāsi.
vsm2.12:109.1: Tena kho pana samayena nandopanandassa nāgarājassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti –
vsm2.12:109.2: ‘‘ime hi nāma muṇḍakā samaṇakā amhākaṃ uparūparibhavanena devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ bhavanaṃ pavisantipi nikkhamantipi,
vsm2.12:109.3: na dāni ito paṭṭhāya imesaṃ amhākaṃ matthake pādapaṃsuṃ okirantānaṃ gantuṃ dassāmī’’ti
vsm2.12:109.4: uṭṭhāya sinerupādaṃ gantvā taṃ attabhāvaṃ vijahitvā
vsm2.12:109.5: sineruṃ sattakkhattuṃ bhogehi parikkhipitvā upari phaṇaṃ katvā
vsm2.12:109.6: tāvatiṃsabhavanaṃ avakujjena phaṇena gahetvā adassanaṃ gamesi.
vsm2.12:110.1: Atha kho āyasmā raṭṭhapālo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
vsm2.12:110.2: ‘‘pubbe, bhante, imasmiṃ padese ṭhito sineruṃ passāmi, sineruparibhaṇḍaṃ passāmi,
vsm2.12:110.3: tāvatiṃsaṃ passāmi, vejayantaṃ passāmi, vejayantassa pāsādassa upari dhajaṃ passāmi.
vsm2.12:110.4: Ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yaṃ etarahi neva sineruṃ passāmi…pe… na vejayantassa pāsādassa upari dhajaṃ passāmī’’ti.
vsm2.12:110.5: ‘‘Ayaṃ, raṭṭhapāla, nandopanando nāma nāgarājā tumhākaṃ kupito sineruṃ sattakkhattuṃ bhogehi parikkhipitvā upari phaṇena paṭicchādetvā andhakāraṃ katvā ṭhito’’ti.
vsm2.12:110.8: Atha kho āyasmā bhaddiyo āyasmā rāhuloti anukkamena sabbepi bhikkhū uṭṭhahiṃsu.
vsm2.12:111.1: Avasāne mahāmoggallānatthero ‘‘ahaṃ, bhante, damemi na’’nti āha.
vsm2.12:111.3: Thero attabhāvaṃ vijahitvā mahantaṃ nāgarājavaṇṇaṃ abhinimminitvā
vsm2.12:111.4: nandopanandaṃ cuddasakkhattuṃ bhogehi parikkhipitvā tassa phaṇamatthake attano phaṇaṃ ṭhapetvā sinerunā saddhiṃ abhinippīḷesi.
vsm2.12:111.6: Theropi na tuyhaṃyeva sarīre dhūmo atthi, mayhampi atthīti padhūmāyi.
vsm2.12:111.7: Nāgarājassa dhūmo theraṃ na bādhati. Therassa pana dhūmo nāgarājānaṃ bādhati.
vsm2.12:111.9: Theropi na tuyhaṃyeva sarīre aggi atthi, mayhampi atthīti pajjali.
vsm2.12:111.10: Nāgarājassa tejo theraṃ na bādhati. Therassa pana tejo nāgarājānaṃ bādhati.
vsm2.12:112.1: Nāgarājā ayaṃ maṃ sinerunā abhinippīḷetvā dhūmāyati ceva pajjalati cāti cintetvā
vsm2.12:112.5: Thero taṃ attabhāvaṃ vijahitvā tassa dakkhiṇakaṇṇasotena pavisitvā vāmakaṇṇasotena nikkhami, vāmakaṇṇasotena pavisitvā dakkhiṇakaṇṇasotena nikkhami,
vsm2.12:112.6: tathā dakkhiṇanāsasotena pavisitvā vāmanāsasotena nikkhami, vāmanāsasotena pavisitvā dakkhiṇanāsasotena nikkhami.
vsm2.12:112.8: Thero mukhena pavisitvā antokucchiyaṃ pācīnena ca pacchimena ca caṅkamati.
vsm2.12:113.1: Bhagavā ‘‘moggallāna, manasikarohi mahiddhiko esa nāgo’’ti āha.
vsm2.12:113.2: Thero ‘‘mayhaṃ kho, bhante, cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā,
vsm2.12:113.3: tiṭṭhatu, bhante, nandopanando, ahaṃ nandopanandasadisānaṃ nāgarājānaṃ satampi sahassampi satasahassampi dameyya’’nti āha.
vsm2.12:114.1: Nāgarājā cintesi ‘‘pavisanto tāva me na diṭṭho, nikkhamanakāle dāni naṃ dāṭhantare pakkhipitvā saṅkhādissāmī’’ti cintetvā
vsm2.12:114.2: nikkhama bhante, mā maṃ antokucchiyaṃ aparāparaṃ caṅkamanto bādhayitthāti āha.
vsm2.12:114.4: Nāgarājā ayaṃ soti disvā nāsavātaṃ vissajji.
vsm2.12:114.5: Thero catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji. Lomakūpampissa vāto cāletuṃ nāsakkhi.
vsm2.12:114.6: Avasesā bhikkhū kira ādito paṭṭhāya sabbapāṭihāriyāni kātuṃ sakkuṇeyyuṃ, imaṃ pana ṭhānaṃ patvā evaṃ khippanisantino hutvā samāpajjituṃ na sakkhissantīti tesaṃ bhagavā nāgarājadamanaṃ nānujāni.
vsm2.12:115.1: Nāgarājā ‘‘ahaṃ imassa samaṇassa nāsavātena lomakūpampi cāletuṃ nāsakkhiṃ, mahiddhiko samaṇo’’ti cintesi.
vsm2.12:115.2: Thero attabhāvaṃ vijahitvā supaṇṇarūpaṃ abhinimminitvā supaṇṇavātaṃ dassento nāgarājānaṃ anubandhi.
vsm2.12:115.3: Nāgarājā taṃ attabhāvaṃ vijahitvā māṇavakavaṇṇaṃ abhinimminitvā ‘‘bhante, tumhākaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmī’’ti vadanto therassa pāde vandi.
vsm2.12:115.4: Thero ‘‘satthā, nanda, āgato, ehi gamissāmā’’ti nāgarājānaṃ damayitvā nibbisaṃ katvā gahetvā bhagavato santikaṃ agamāsi.
vsm2.12:116.1: Nāgarājā bhagavantaṃ vanditvā ‘‘bhante, tumhākaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmī’’ti āha.
vsm2.12:116.2: Bhagavā ‘‘sukhī hohi, nāgarājā’’ti vatvā bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto anāthapiṇḍikassa nivesanaṃ agamāsi.
vsm2.12:116.4: Moggallānassa ca nandopanandassa ca saṅgāmo ahosīti.
vsm2.12:116.7: Anāthapiṇḍiko ‘‘adhivāsetu me, bhante, bhagavā sattāhaṃ ekapaṭipāṭiyā bhattaṃ, sattāhaṃ therassa sakkāraṃ karissāmī’’ti vatvā
vsm2.12:116.8: sattāhaṃ buddhapamukhānaṃ pañcannaṃ bhikkhusatānaṃ mahāsakkāraṃ akāsi.
vsm2.12:117.1: Iti imaṃ imasmiṃ nandopanandadamane kataṃ mahantaṃ attabhāvaṃ sandhāyetaṃ vuttaṃ
vsm2.12:117.2: ‘‘yadā mahantaṃ attabhāvaṃ karoti, tadā mahantaṃ hoti mahāmoggallānattherassa viyā’’ti.
vsm2.12:117.3: Evaṃ vuttepi bhikkhū upādiṇṇakaṃ nissāya anupādiṇṇakameva vaḍḍhatīti āhaṃsu.
